note: Clause 1: TestRFC2866AccountingRetransmitWithoutDelayTimeKeepsIdentifier goes red on a changed Identifier for identical contents. Clause 2: TestRFC2866AccountingRetransmitTakesANewIdentifierAndRequestAuthenticator forces a retransmit whose Acct-Delay-Time moves 0->1 and asserts a new Identifier, a new Request Authenticator, and each authenticator equal to the Section 3 MD5 of its own datagram. The two clauses are opposite polarities of one rule, so a client that always or never changes the ID goes red. TestRFC2866AccountingDistinctRequestsDifferIdentifier is mislabeled: it proves RFC2866-4.1-4.
